sentences.text: In a cellular study, researchers observed that stimulating neurons caused branching dendrites to immobilize vesicles at active translation spots, whereas axons accelerated the movement of these structures.
A specific type of stimulation increased the proportion of vesicles carrying ribosomes, thereby expanding the local supply of these ribosome-associated particles.
Imaging of individual mRNA molecules revealed that translation sites linked to these vesicles generated approximately 30% more new protein signal than sites lacking them.
The findings suggest these vesicles may act as specialized platforms connecting neural activity signals with local protein production to regulate translation timing and location.
